lesson.pre_a1_modelo: This is our apartment. The view is beautiful.

listenings.text: Hi! Welcome back. I am Tom, your neighbor. My apartment is 1206. My wife is Rosa. Her family is from Cuba. Our dog is Max. His bed is near our door, so he is always there. The pool is open today. Have a good week!

Hello, everyone. This is Karen, your building manager. Your new keys are at the front desk. Please write your name and your apartment number on the paper there. The pool is closed on Monday. On Tuesday, it is open again. Thank you, and welcome to all our new neighbors.

extra_audio.text: Eliane and her husband are in Miami. Their building is on Bay Street. Eliane says: My key is in my bag. Their neighbor is Tom. His wife is Rosa.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: the person in the next apartment
what you see from the window
a big house with many apartments

paras: This is Eliane. She is in Miami with her husband. Their apartment is in a tall building on Bay Street. Their apartment is on floor twelve. The view is beautiful: the sea and the city.
Eliane says: My key is in my bag. And your key? Her husband says: My key is here, in my hand. They are home.
Their neighbor is Tom. His apartment is 1206. His wife is Rosa. Her family is from Cuba, and her English is very fast! The pool is on the roof. Eliane says: Our building is our second home.
